spacing.note: single 100vh stage, no scroll; values are positions measured from the 1440x900 screenshot, not a CSS scale

image_ratios.ratio: full viewport WebGL2 canvas (1800x1125 at 1.25 dpr)

grid.note: corner-anchored chrome around a centred circular stage

taste.name: Drawn in light, not modelled
taste.trigger: When the product (a car) had to carry the whole first screen
taste.decision: Chose a dark stage where the car exists only as glowing strokes over a shaded, textured 3D model
taste.reason: Because the subject is sound, which nobody can see; light-trails read as energy moving through the body, which a photoreal car would hide behind paint
evidence: car outline in white + #BAC529 strokes with a faint floor reflection

taste.name: The circle is the navigation
taste.trigger: When five sequential steps (Body style → Engine → Presets → Customize → Calculate) needed a progress UI
taste.decision: Chose nodes strung along a ~960px ring around the car over a top tab bar or a linear sidebar
taste.reason: Because the ring frames the object and the journey at once; the eye never leaves the car to check where it is
evidence: 5 circular nodes ~68px apart on the left arc
option label 'HATCHBACK' pinned to the right arc
active node: inset 2px white ring + 8px/4px white glow at 0.15

taste.name: One accent, the rest is white at volume levels
taste.trigger: When the UI needed hierarchy across title, active, upcoming and disabled states
taste.decision: Chose pure #FFFFFF at opacity 1 / 0.8 / 0.6 / 0.4 / 0.3 plus a single lime #BAC529 over a grey ramp or a multi-colour state palette
taste.reason: Because opacity on a dark stage dims like a fader on a mixing desk; every state stays the same hue, so the lime reads as 'this is the brand / this is selected' and nothing else competes
evidence: lime only on logo, active language, muted #C2CB88 on the selected option

taste.name: Instrument-panel labelling
taste.trigger: When setting even the explanatory sentence under the title
taste.decision: Chose uppercase tracked type everywhere (10px DIN at 0.18em for the lede) over sentence-case body copy
taste.reason: Because short tracked caps read like labels on hardware; the page asks you to tune, not to read
evidence: no element uses text-transform: none except the cookie bar
